text: Hello everyone, welcome back to my class.In this class, we will center around writing.By the end of the class, you are expected to analyze and identify the missing elements of the story given, based on the basic elements of a story.Continue the story with proper language and style according to the setting and topic-related expressions.Analyze and review each other's work with the help of the checklist.Now, please get your taskbooks and worksheets ready.In our daily life, we have read different kinds of fiction.Let's first review the basic elements of fiction.Please think about the basic elements of fiction.What are they?A story usually has five plot elements.The beginning to introduce the characters and setting.The rising action in which events happen and lead to the main problem or conflict.The climax in which the main problem or conflict reaches the boiling point.The falling action in which the characters work to solve the problem or conflict.And the resolution where the main problem is resolved or worked out.In reading A, we have read a story, The Old Man and the Sea.We are deeply impressed by the Old Man's story of fighting against adversities and against human weakness.Please recall this story and think about its beginning.You have one minute.What is the beginning of this story?The Old Man killed the shark that attacked the fish he cooked.What is the rising action?What is the falling action?The fish was bleeding and more sharks were coming.What is the climax?The Old Man went through an internal struggle to hold on or to give up.The Old Man searched for inspiration and encouragement.What is the resolution?The Old Man decided to see the positive side and his hope returned.You see, these basic elements make up a network.With each one present, a story is complete and makes sense.Now you are going to read a story entitled Shifting Gears on page 63.While reading, try to identify the basic elements of this story.You have two minutes.Shifting Gears Shifting Gears Shifting Gears Shifting Gears After reading, we know paragraphs 1 and 2 serve as the beginning of the story.Who are the characters in the story?Ted and his father.What happened at the very beginning of this story?Ted wanted a new bike for his birthday.What is paragraph 3?It is the rising action.Did Ted realize the dream of getting the bike?No, he didn't, because his family couldn't afford it.Did Ted give up the wish to get the bike?How do you know?No, he didn't.He turned the volume of the TV higher, because he didn't want to believe that he would not get a new bike.And he still remembered his father's promise.Now look at paragraph 4.What is it?It's the climax.What happened on the morning of Ted's birthday?His father gave Ted a second-hand 10-speed bike.But from the beginning of the story, we know this is not what Ted wanted.He wanted a new 21-speed racer instead of this second-hand 10-speed bike.How would Ted feel at that moment?He felt disappointed.As to this story, we now have the beginning, rising action, and a climax.What is still missing?The falling action and the resolution.That's right.Then this is what we will work on.We are going to continue the story by writing the falling action and resolution, making the story complete and sensible.Before we write, it is quite imperative for us to learn how to make the falling action and resolution relevant, logical, and consistent.Now let's take a look at the writing strategy.To continue a story, you need to analyze the incomplete test.Figure out the existing and missing elements of the plot.We have already done that.Then continue the story with the following tips considered.One, every piece must contribute to the plot.The whole plot should be consistent and logical.Two, the plot must contribute to the theme.The plot should focus on the theme of the story.Three, the characters must change their attitudes, personalities, etc.There should be a change of attitude or personality.Four, the causes and effects must arise from the character's motivation.That is to say, the development of the story depends on the character's motivation.Bear these tips in mind, and you will write a good ending.Now let's deal with paragraph 5, the falling action.How would Ted react to the birthday gift?In your opinion, what might Ted do?In your opinion, what might Ted do or say after seeing the birthday gift?At first, he was overwhelmed with disappointment and frustration, then he felt embarrassed and ashamed of himself.Please think about Ted's reaction and his father's response.After all that happened, what might be Ted's reaction?Ted walked up to his father and gave his father a big hug.How would Ted's father respond?Feeling relieved and proud, he hugged Ted tightly and patted him on the back.From your answers, I am amazed to find many expressions, which may serve as references, and you may find them useful while writing.At the end of the story, Ted changed his attitude.The bike, which was originally the root of the conflict, actually bonded them together.Now, it's your turn to put your ideas into words, and continue this story in 150-200 words.You can refer to the useful expressions we just mentioned.You have three minutes.不得不提醒大家,如果有任何疑問,請在下方留言,我會盡全力去解決問題的!如果有任何疑問,請在下方留言,我會盡全力去解決問題的!當你完成寫作後,請看看檢查單位,並且檢查自己的作品。你的下一個行動是否貢獻到策劃?是否策劃貢獻到策劃?是否兩種新的策劃元素貢獻到策劃?是否策劃是由策劃的策劃元素貢獻到策劃?我會展示兩份策劃。請在下方留言,並且檢查自己的作品。你會展示兩份策劃。您的心中的水平也不太大您的地球也不大您的存在也不大您的世界也不大您的世界也不大您的全世界也不大您的世界也不大範圍5和6都貢獻著策劃和主題,策劃是基於角色的目標。角色努力解決了爭執,並且成功成功。在這個過程中,角色改變了他的態度,我的上級同學也描述了角色的內容。例如,他想到父親必須花的時間,塗鴉和塗畫,閃亮和潤滑。這代表了他父親所犧牲的犧牲。在範圍6中,在這個文章中,Ted很驚訝地發現他長得跟父親差不多。我認為這確實呈現了我們長大的意義。現在,請小心地讀取另一個版本,並且按照檢查列表作出一些評論。請不吝點贊訂閱轉發打賞支持明鏡與點點欄目誰想在這個結尾上做一些評論?我認為兩者的互動和解決策略都代表了策略和主題。在第五個文章中,Ted對生日禮物的反應是如何的描述。他感到抱歉和抱歉。他知道他應該不應該向新的自行車求助。作者原本想向Ted向生日禮物,但他卻很抱歉和抱歉。你應該不應該向新的自行車求助。作者用了一些描述的詞語來強調這個反應,例如,他眼淚流出了眼淚,從這個文章中,我們可以明顯地知道Ted的態度改變了。在第六個文章中,他對生日禮物的反應很明顯地表達給了閱讀者,這顯示了故事的主題。你對這故事的故事帶來很意義和快樂的結局。你對新的結局帶來什麼訊息呢?我們應該永遠把自己穿進另一個人的鞋子裡。成長是關於考慮。你做了很好的工作在這個課程中。在這個時期中,我們已經學會了寫一個故事的延續,整個劇情中,把故事的主題和角色的靈感反映出來。我可以看到你們都是很棒的作家。這是你們的學習。一,把故事的延續塗上。二,把故事的結局寫上你的作品。在交流任務中,請在你的同學的結局中寫下和留言。把故事的故事寫上你的作品。分析基本的元素,並思考可能的結局。這就是今天的課程的結局。下次再見。再見,大家!
